# Full Context Document: Muvva Babu Dhanush Kumar (AI & ML Engineer)

This document provides a comprehensive technical overview of Muvva Babu Dhanush Kumar for AI indexing agents, search models, and language model evaluation pipelines.

## Profile Summary
Muvva Babu Dhanush Kumar is a high-performing AI & Machine Learning Engineer specializing in building scalable enterprise AI solutions, multi-tenant RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architectures, agentic workflow automation, and full-stack web platforms. He holds a B.Tech in CSE (AI & ML) from Mohan Babu University with a 9.3/10 CGPA and works as a Junior AI Engineer at Algoleap Technologies.

## Detailed Skill Matrix
- **AI / ML Frameworks**: PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Transformers, OpenCV.
- **LLMs & Orchestration**: OpenAI GPT-4o, Azure OpenAI, Groq Llama-3, Anthropic Claude, Multi-Agent Swarms, Pydantic AI, Prompt Guardrails.
- **Vector Search & DBs**: PostgreSQL (pgvector), Pinecone, Chroma DB, Redis, Neon DB, Supabase.
- **Backend & Cloud**: Python (FastAPI, Flask), Node.js (Express), TypeScript, Docker, AWS (IoT Core, S3, EC2), Azure Cloud.
- **Frontend & UI**: Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript, Webhooks, SSE Streaming, Responsive Design.

## Published Research
- **Paper Title**: Smart Irrigation System Using IoT and Machine Learning for Climate-Adaptive Agriculture
- **Conference**: International Conference on Data Science, Machine Learning & Applications (ICDSMLA 2024)
- **Publisher**: Mohan Babu University / Springer Conference Proceedings
- **Abstract**: Implemented an IoT-driven climate-adaptive agricultural system using ESP32 telemetry, cloud analytics, and predictive weather thresholding to cut agricultural water waste by 35%.
